code:
import SpriteKit

func makePlayer() -> SKNode {
    let player = SKNode()
    player.name = "player"
    let body = SKShapeNode(rectOf: CGSize(width: 54, height: 72), cornerRadius: 14)
    body.fillColor = .systemBlue
    body.strokeColor = .white
    body.lineWidth = 3
    player.addChild(body)
    let head = SKShapeNode(circleOfRadius: 24)
    head.position.y = 58
    head.fillColor = .systemOrange
    player.addChild(head)
    return player
}

func makeFire() -> SKEmitterNode {
    let fire = SKEmitterNode()
    fire.particleTexture = SKTexture(imageNamed: "spark")
    fire.particleBirthRate = 90
    fire.particleLifetime = 1.2
    fire.particleSpeed = 130
    fire.particleSpeedRange = 45
    fire.emissionAngle = .pi / 2
    fire.emissionAngleRange = .pi / 5
    fire.particleColor = .orange
    fire.particleColorBlendFactor = 1
    fire.particleAlphaSpeed = -0.8
    fire.particleBlendMode = .add
    fire.advanceSimulationTime(0.8)
    return fire
}
